{
  "format": "toolroll-flow",
  "version": 1,
  "name": "every kind, as the lead writes them",
  "about": "Inbox → Triage → Sort → Build → Review → Open PR → Tell them → Wait for reply → Call CRM → Post it → Draft reply → Owner says → Pick → Send → Overnight → Note it → Mate → Comment → Research → Elsewhere → Done",
  "needs": [
    "email",
    "github",
    "openrouter",
    "script:triage",
    "secret:CRM_KEY",
    "subagent:maya",
    "subagent:theo",
    "tool:slack"
  ],
  "parameters": [
    {
      "id": "decider-review",
      "about": "Who decides at Review: a person's sign-in name, owner (the flow's owner) or anyone",
      "default": "owner"
    },
    {
      "id": "email-to-ping",
      "about": "Who Tell them emails"
    }
  ],
  "zones": [
    {
      "id": "inbox",
      "title": "Inbox",
      "kind": "inbox",
      "remindAfter": "2 days",
      "thenMoveTo": "triage",
      "next": "triage",
      "at": {
        "x": 0,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "slate"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "triage",
      "title": "Triage",
      "kind": "check",
      "script": "triage",
      "runIn": "folder",
      "secrets": [
        "CRM_KEY"
      ],
      "routes": [
        {
          "answer": "bug",
          "goesTo": "sort"
        },
        {
          "answer": "other",
          "goesTo": "done"
        }
      ],
      "next": "sort",
      "ifFails": "inbox",
      "at": {
        "x": 360,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "blue"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "sort",
      "title": "Sort",
      "kind": "sort",
      "question": "How urgent is it?",
      "answers": [
        {
          "answer": "Urgent",
          "means": "Customers are blocked",
          "goesTo": "build"
        },
        {
          "answer": "Later",
          "means": "Later",
          "goesTo": "inbox"
        }
      ],
      "sureAt": 85,
      "alsoNote": [
        {
          "id": "does-it-mention-money",
          "question": "Does it mention money?",
          "kind": "yes-no"
        },
        {
          "id": "how-big",
          "question": "How big?",
          "kind": "score",
          "levels": [
            "small",
            "big"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "ifNotSure": "inbox",
      "at": {
        "x": 720,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "violet"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "build",
      "title": "Build",
      "kind": "task",
      "instructions": "Fix {{card.title}}. Notes: {{stage.sort}}",
      "planning": "required",
      "next": "review",
      "at": {
        "x": 1080,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "blue"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "review",
      "title": "Review",
      "kind": "approval",
      "decider": "{{param.decider-review}}",
      "remindAfter": "1 day",
      "next": "pr",
      "ifFails": "build",
      "at": {
        "x": 1440,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "amber"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "pr",
      "title": "Open PR",
      "kind": "pull-request",
      "merge": "squash",
      "next": "ping",
      "ifFails": "build",
      "at": {
        "x": 1800,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "blue"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "ping",
      "title": "Tell them",
      "kind": "email",
      "to": "{{param.email-to-ping}}",
      "subject": "Fixed: {{card.title}}",
      "body": "It's done.",
      "next": "hold",
      "at": {
        "x": 2160,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "green"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "hold",
      "title": "Wait for reply",
      "kind": "wait",
      "waitFor": "reply",
      "wait": "3 days",
      "next": "call",
      "ifNoReply": "done",
      "at": {
        "x": 2520,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "slate"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "call",
      "title": "Call CRM",
      "kind": "request",
      "method": "POST",
      "url": "https://crm.example.com/api/notes",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer {{secret.CRM_KEY}}"
      },
      "body": "{\"note\": \"{{card.title}}\"}",
      "next": "use",
      "at": {
        "x": 2880,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "blue"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "use",
      "title": "Post it",
      "kind": "tool",
      "server": "slack",
      "tool": "post_message",
      "args": "{\"text\":\"{{stage.draft-reply}}\"}",
      "next": "draft-reply",
      "at": {
        "x": 3240,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "blue"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "draft-reply",
      "title": "Draft reply",
      "kind": "draft",
      "instructions": "Write a short, friendly reply to the person who sent this card, in plain words.",
      "next": "owner-says",
      "at": {
        "x": 3600,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "violet"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "owner-says",
      "title": "Owner says",
      "kind": "approval",
      "decider": "owner",
      "subagent": "maya",
      "next": "pick",
      "ifFails": "build",
      "at": {
        "x": 3960,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "amber"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "pick",
      "title": "Pick",
      "kind": "choose",
      "options": [
        {
          "label": "Ship",
          "goesTo": "send"
        },
        {
          "label": "Drop",
          "goesTo": "end"
        }
      ],
      "remindAfter": "2 days",
      "thenMoveTo": "done",
      "ifReplied": "build",
      "at": {
        "x": 4320,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "amber"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "send",
      "title": "Send",
      "kind": "send",
      "next": "overnight",
      "at": {
        "x": 4680,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 220,
        "color": "green"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overnight",
      "title": "Overnight",
      "kind": "wait",
      "waitFor": "hours",
      "from": "22:00",
      "until": "06:00",
      "next": "note-it",
      "at": {
        "x": 5040,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "slate"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "note-it",
      "title": "Note it",
      "kind": "notify",
      "message": "Update on {{card.title}}",
      "next": "mate",
      "at": {
        "x": 5400,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 220,
        "color": "green"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "mate",
      "title": "Mate",
      "kind": "subagent",
      "instructions": "Read the card and decide what happens next.",
      "routes": [
        {
          "answer": "Done",
          "goesTo": "done"
        }
      ],
      "subagent": "theo",
      "reply": true,
      "next": "comment",
      "at": {
        "x": 5760,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "violet"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "comment",
      "title": "Comment",
      "kind": "update",
      "message": "Done: {{card.title}}",
      "close": false,
      "next": "research",
      "at": {
        "x": 6120,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "green"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "research",
      "title": "Research",
      "kind": "report",
      "instructions": "Investigate this and write a short, clear report with a summary first: {{card.title}}\n\n{{card.description}}\n\nFeedback to address (if any): {{note}}",
      "next": "elsewhere",
      "at": {
        "x": 6480,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "violet"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "elsewhere",
      "title": "Elsewhere",
      "kind": "task",
      "instructions": "{{card.title}}\n\n{{card.description}}\n\nNotes from Research:\n{{stage.research}}\n\nChanges asked for (if any): {{note}}",
      "planning": "auto",
      "next": "done",
      "at": {
        "x": 6840,
        "y": 0,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 300,
        "color": "blue"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "title": "Done",
      "kind": "done",
      "at": {
        "x": 720,
        "y": 380,
        "w": 260,
        "h": 220,
        "color": "green"
      }
    }
  ],
  "triggers": [],
  "scripts": [
    {
      "name": "triage",
      "about": "Says whether the report is a bug",
      "language": "python",
      "timeoutMinutes": 15,
      "body": "print('goto: bug')"
    }
  ]
}
